| [[main:{{{1}}}|{{{2|{{{1}}}}}}]]</includeonly><noinclude>
Adds an item to a FAQ list.

Usage: <nowiki>{{ FAQ2 | ''name'' }}</nowiki> or <nowiki>{{ FAQ | ''link'' | ''name'' }}</nowiki>

where ''link'' is the page name to be linked,
and ''name'' is optional text to be used for the link

(similar to standard <nowiki>[[ link | name ]]</nowiki> syntax)
